verification_scope.irm: All twenty native DOC/DOT files lack a DataSpaces graph, including the encrypted native DOC. Library-authored legacy-binary IRM metadata on native document/macro parents retains publishing-license and certificate XML plus a clearly non-encrypted sentinel payload. Exact identity/payload reinterpretation refusals keep staging unchanged; no-op publication, file reopen, logical-stream preservation, inverse and stale-license patch rejection pass. Public native text remains unchanged; no protected data is decrypted or authorized.
verification_scope.rtf: Eight explicitly injected controls (jsksu, jsku, horzvert, gcw, twoinone, nosectexpand, sectexpand, jclisttab) retain exact bytes and their body anchor after RTF_MINIMAL_006. Four pre-existing native opaque controls remain. Canonical body writing preserves text/fonts/opaque nodes, exact save preserves source bytes, and an eleven-node quota rejects twelve nodes with exact counts. A header derivative retains HeaderFooter anchors and refuses canonical output before any bytes are written.
verification_scope.xlsb: The native links/objects package really contains five rich-data parts, metadata.bin and a local-image payload. Digests pin metadata and the image. Inserting J50=42.5 changes exactly sheet1.bin and binaryIndex1.bin; every rich-data/relationship/image/other member stays exact. All original cells retain value, formula bytes and style; eager/indexed reads agree, and file reopen/replay/inverse pass. This does not expose a typed rich-value model.
verification_scope.ppt: Two native decks start without comments. Explicit Comment 2000 additions preserve exact author/initials/Unicode text/date/index/coordinates through update/removal. Catalog validation, file save/reopen, replay and exact inverse pass at each stage. All slide drawing payloads, unselected slide envelopes, main/notes/handout masters and non-presentation streams remain unchanged.
verification_scope.python: Native XLSX/XLSM parents receive a specified Python part/relationship and an uncached PY(0,0) formula derivative. Auto/Eager evaluation returns Calc::Error::Unsupported through Code::UnsupportedCapability, reports remain Unsupported, and ordinary scalar edits/reopen retain script/relationship bytes and the macro payload. The code strings are inert; there is no native-authored Python specimen or executed script.
verification_scope.declared_paths: On native XLS/PPT parents, the existing public vocabulary produces precise declared errors: XLS threadedComment is UnsupportedPath without a format element, XLS slicer is UnsupportedCapability, and PPT modernComment/smartart are UnsupportedCapability matching their capability gaps. Unknown or invented person/richValue/timeline paths are not used as evidence for runtime support boundaries.
verification_scope.other_reviews: Existing native classic notes, pivot caches/caption edits, array/shared/dynamic storage, future-function/external calculation refusals, SmartArt PNG fallback and all-deck diagram-build absence checks were rerun. Their supported scope remains distinct from modern threads, slicer/timeline execution, rich-value/spill engines or full diagram authoring.
verification_scope.limits: No native-app reopen/rendering, IRM rights evaluation, protected-content access, Python/control/macro execution, external retrieval or provider refresh was performed. Library-authored derivatives are labeled explicitly, and excluded semantics never gain positive coverage.
